new_results.statement: If p_Y<=m and 0<beta<1, then sup_s E|Y-s|^-beta <= (2m)^beta/(1-beta).

For a source-valid rank-one I-J grouped cross packet with aggregate resource kappa, the packet density has ||p||_p <= p 2^((p-1)/p) kappa^(-(p-1)/p), p>1, even with arbitrary I-side measurable curvature and conditioning-generated J-affine term.
A source-disjoint grouped square with resource rho has explicit L^(p/(p-1)) density norm <= 2^(2/p)((p-1)/(p-2))^((p-1)/p) rho^(-1/p), p>2.

On disjoint original-coordinate banks, a rank-one grouped bilinear/affine-slope packet plus one independent grouped square has p_Q in C0 and ||p_Q||_infinity <= K_p kappa^(-(p-1)/p) rho^(-1/p); at p=3, <=12 kappa^(-2/3)rho^(-1/3).

For normalized all-ones vectors on three disjoint size-m banks, Q=2(a^T X_I)(b^T X_J)+(z^T X_D)^2 has spectrum {-1,1,1}, max diagonal 1/m, max physical 2x2 determinant 1/m^2, yet ||p_Q||_infinity<=12 and p_Q in C0 for every cap-one product law.
